# Stone Heritage Mukteshwar

> Authentic Kumaoni heritage homestay in Mukteshwar, Uttarakhand. Premier mountain retreat featuring panoramic Himalayan Nanda Devi peak views, authentic stone architecture, homemade vegetarian Kumaoni dining, high-speed optical fiber WiFi, and 100% pet-friendly stone cottages.

## 2. Room Categories & Accommodations
Stone Heritage offers 7 unique room and suite configurations built with local stone and wood:
- **Stonewood Family Retreat:** Luxury family suite featuring 2 King Beds, spacious living area, and panoramic Himalayan mountain views.
- **Copper Room:** Premium room featuring 1 King Bed and 1 Single Bed, suitable for up to 3 guests.
- **Brass Room:** Quadroom featuring King Bali floor mattress setup with private ensuite washroom.
- **The Vintage Room:** Classic Kumaoni heritage room featuring 1 King Bed and stone-carved walls.
- **Stone & Story Room:** Boutique suite featuring 1 King Bed with sitting area and scenic view windows.
- **Iron Room:** Rustic-modern fusion room with 1 King Bed and handcrafted furniture.
- **Cedar Room:** Cozy economy option with 1 King Bed, ideal for budget-conscious solo travelers or couples.

## 3. Key Amenities & Guest Features
- **Unobstructed Mountain Views:** Direct sunrise and sunset views of the snow-capped Nanda Devi Himalayan range.
- **Authentic Kumaoni Dining:** Freshly cooked vegetarian meals prepared by Chef Akshay using locally sourced organic ingredients.
- **Workcation Ready:** Dedicated high-speed optical fiber WiFi (100+ Mbps) and power backup.
- **100% Pet-Friendly:** Private gardens and open green lawns welcoming dogs and pets of all sizes.
- **Bonfire & BBQ Nights:** Evening outdoor campfire setups and stargazing experiences under clear mountain skies.
